name: ArrStalledHandler
description: ArrStalledHandler is a Python-based script designed to handle stalled downloads in Radarr and Sonarr by taking actions such as removing, blocklisting, or blocklisting and re-searching for the affected items.

variables.name: Radarr URL
variables.description: The base URL for Radarr (ex. http://192.168.1.100:7878). Leave empty to disable Radarr-functionality. Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: The API key for Radarr (found in Radarr settings). Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Sonarr URL
variables.description: The base URL for Sonarr (ex. http://192.168.1.100:8989). Leave empty to disable Sonarr-functionality. Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Sonarr API Key
variables.description: The API key for Sonarr (found in Sonarr settings). Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Lidarr URL
variables.description: The base URL for Lidarr (ex. http://192.168.1.100:8686). Leave empty to disable Lidarr-functionality. Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: The API key for Lidarr (found in Lidarr settings). Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Readarr URL
variables.description: The base URL for Readarr (ex. http://192.168.1.100:8787). Leave empty to disable Readarr-functionality. Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Readarr API Key
variables.description: The API key for Readarr (found in Readarr settings). Comma seperated list for multiple instances.

variables.name: Stalled Timeout
variables.description: Time (in seconds) a download must remain stalled before actions are taken.

variables.name: Stalled Action
variables.description: Action to perform on stalled downloads: REMOVE, BLOCKLIST, or BLOCKLIST_AND_SEARCH.

variables.name: Verbose Logging
variables.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging (true or false).

variables.name: Count ´Downloading Metadata´ as stalled
variables.description: Count the qBittorrent status of ´Downloading Metadata´ as stalled.
